lines.text: OAK: Good to see you!\nAnd how is your Pokédex coming along?\c\nHere, let me take a look...
Your current progress on your Pokédex is...\c\n[VAR NUM3(0004)] Pokémon seen and [VAR NUM3(0005)] Pokémon caught!\nAnd Professor Oak’s judgment is...
You’re just getting started.\c\nGo into every patch of grass you see and look\nfor Pokémon!

It looks as though you’re getting
on the right track!\c
I’d bet you’re getting better at throwing out
the ol’ Poké Balls, too, eh?
Your Pokédex still needs a lot of filling before it\ncan really be called a true Pokédex!\c\nAlways look out for new places to explore!

Mm-hmm... It’s clear you’re trying hard!\c
I’ve told one of my assistants to set you up with
the Judge function. He’s waiting at the gate on
Route 11, so be sure to get it from him!

Your Pokédex is coming along quite well!\c
I gave an assistant a Poké Ball set for you.
He’s waiting at the gate on Route 16, so be sure
to get it from him!

Ah, you’ve finally topped 50 species!\c
I’ve given one of my assistants a wonderful item.
He’s waiting at the gate on Route 15, so be sure
to get it from him!
Hoho! This is turning into quite the respectable\nPokédex, I’d say!
Very good! You can find Water-type Pokémon\nin rivers and the ocean, so use Sea Skim if you\r\nwant to catch them!
Wonderful! Let me guess...\nYou like to collect things, don’t you?
Now this... This is truly impressive!\nIt must have been difficult to collect so many!
You’ve finally hit 100 species!\nSuch skill! It’s hard to believe!
You’re even filling in Pokémon’s Evolutions now!\nSuperb!
Excellent! Perhaps if you trade with friends,\nyou’ll collect even more!
Outstanding! By the time this Pokédex is\ncompleted, you’ll be a true pro!
I have nothing left to say!\nYou’re the Pokémon Professor now!
You’ve completed a perfect Pokédex!\nCongratulations!

You’ve done it...
You’ve really, truly done it now!\c
You’ve completed a perfectly complete Pokédex!
It’s magnificent! Truly, this is a fantastic feat!
Wroooooooaaaaaarrrr!
Thank you, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\nI sincerely thank you!\r\nYou’ve made my dream a reality!

OAK: Ah, welcome!
Tell me, how is the old Pokédex coming along?\c
Wahaha!\c
Actually, I already know how it is, but I love
seeing it again anyway!\c
Let’s see...
